verdict.rationale: Cua documents running Spaces on hardware you choose: a Mac on your desk, a LAN or Tailscale server running cua-spacesd, or a VM in your own AWS, Google Cloud or Modal account. The SDK also runs locally via Docker, Podman, QEMU or Lume, so Space data can sit on infrastructure you control. However, nothing documents selecting a region or residency for Cua's own hosted services, such as the account-wide Cua Volume or the relay. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for Cua-hosted storage, documentation of where the Cua Volume data lives, independent corroboration.
